session_note: AXIS chosen by the agent as MASS/ADD: the only untested half of the dose curve in this ledger, and the only arm whose failure mode is bounded by the mass penalty alone (T is a max over dots).

parent.r0_rebuilt_from: pinned h27-4 solo-d2.8 mask & (Euclidean d_cat > 2 px)

operator.quota_rule: quota_b = n_add * r0_dots_b / R0_DOTS, largest remainder, capped at min(capacity_b, 0.5*r0_dots_b); zero where r0_dots_b = 0
operator.eligibility: H19-5 support & footprint & ~catalogue & Euclidean d_cat >= 3.0 px & unoccupied
operator.blocknext_rule: ascending parent FIFO-BFS visit rank within each block quota
operator.gapmax_rule: greedy maximum marginal R=3 px triangular-kernel credit on the support within each block quota

model.algebra: dDTI_i = [E_i(D-0.2T) - 0.2T(1-c_i)]/D^2 with E_i = precision * marginal_support_credit_i, c_i = precision * full_support_credit_i
model.support_precision_note: precision = P(a support pixel is a new-fault truth pixel); point 0.20 is the value implied by T/(support_px*0.7) under the point parent fit, bracketed 0.10-0.35

proxies.catalogue_hide_recover: analytically zero for additions (d_cat >= 3 px, R = 3 px) - REPORT ONLY
proxies.leakage_canary: not re-run this session: no new feature was introduced (additions are placed on the existing H19-5 support)

sgmc_off_catalogue_credit.status: REPORT ONLY (never a gate, never a live score)

catalogue_hide_recover.status: REPORT ONLY (never a gate, never a live score)
catalogue_hide_recover.reason: Analytic, not measured: every added dot has Euclidean d_cat >= 3.0 px and the kernel radius is 3 px, so additions supply exactly zero kernel credit to any known catalogue pixel. The instrument is blind to this axis by construction (same caveat as IR90-19).

mechanism_card.hypothesis: R0 is under-massed, not over-massed, at the margin: 3765 additional unit dots placed on the parent's own H19-5 evidence, following the parent's regional distribution, should add more truth credit T than the 0.2 mass each dot costs, raising DTI.
mechanism_card.mechanism: DTI = T/(0.2T + 0.2(S-M) + 0.8|G|). For one added unit dot dDTI = [E(D-0.2T) - 0.2T(1-c)]/D^2, so an addition pays iff its exclusive truth credit E exceeds ~0.056 (0.2*DTI at the claimed 0.2778). Additions can never reduce T (T is a max over dots), so unlike a deletion the failure mode is bounded by the mass penalty alone. Placement here is the parent's own thinning rank (the cells its d2.8 recipe suppressed, earliest visit first) inside a per-block quota.
mechanism_card.non_fault_confounder: The H19-5 field is a topographic/structural-ridge response, not a fault map: ridges from lithologic contacts, erosion-resistant beds, drainage margins and shoreline features carry the same signature, and the parent lineage's 0.2778 CLAIM cannot separate them. If the field is < 11% precise for new faults, the mass penalty dominates and the addition loses; if the belt is largely non-fault ridge, R0 is already over-placed there and the gapmax arm simply re-covers the same ridges more evenly.
mechanism_card.predicted_live_change: +0.0044 DTI point (MODEL; bracket +0.0003 to +0.0107; not a score)
mechanism_card.falsifier: Paired same-week live receipt against R0: Delta <= -0.010 falsifies the under-massed hypothesis at this dose and supports the deletion ladder; |Delta| < 0.010 is no evidence under the session rule. The decisive contrast is gapmax10 vs blocknext10 at identical dose and geography: gapmax >= +0.010 with blocknext null means placement (kernel room) matters; both null means the support is saturated.
mechanism_card.structural_geologist_note: Additions are 10.0% of the parent, all on the corroborated H19-5 ridge support, all >= 3 px from mapped USGS/INGENIOUS traces, quota-proportional to the parent's own 5 km block counts (p05 share 0.087, max 0.120). Read the rendered file as a denser sampling of the same ridge network, not as a new structural interpretation.
